primary_endpoint: exact expected discounted external terminal reward minus discounted start-time probe fees
comparisons: all policies evaluated on the true joint kernel; retain every cell and negative gain
simulated_clock_unit: declared model time unit; not hardware seconds
deadline_rule: outcomes with duration greater than remaining time collapse to timeout at deadline; sum their likelihoods before conditioning
failure_rule: fees and full observed elapsed duration retained
fee_rule: one launch fee per probe at launch time; no additional latency tariff
compute_cost: measured process CPU and perf_counter wall reported separately; not converted to objective units
selection: no fitting or hyperparameter selection on these outcomes; exact enumeration over all histories
